plugins.name: tuanjie
plugins.description: Tuanjie Engine (团结引擎) game-development skills — ported from Unity's official agent plugin and adapted for Tuanjie: editor-binary automation, the packages.unity.cn registry, WeChat Mini Game and China-market guidance. 27 skills spanning UI (uGUI / UI Toolkit / IMGUI), the full 2D and Tilemap set, AI navigation, 3D physics, URP migration and post-processing, sprite editing, Shader Graph custom nodes, audio and TextMeshPro optimization, localization, IAP, and Tuanjie editor command-line automation.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 团结引擎（Tuanjie Engine）游戏开发技能包。基于 Unity 官方 agent 插件移植并针对团结引擎改造：Tuanjie 编辑器命令行自动化、packages.unity.cn 包管理、微信小游戏与国内渠道指引。内含 27 个技能，覆盖 UI（uGUI / UI Toolkit / IMGUI）、完整 2D 与 Tilemap 工具集、AI 导航、3D 物理、URP 迁移与后处理、精灵编辑、Shader Graph 自定义节点、音频与 TextMeshPro 优化、本地化、内购，以及团结引擎命令行自动化。
